mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.content, c.status, c.created_at as createdAt, c.target_type as targetType, c.target_id as targetId, u.id as userId, u.nickname as userName, u.avatar as userAvatar FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE status = 1

SELECT r.id, r.content, r.status, r.created_at as createdAt, r.comment_id as commentId, u.id as userId, u.nickname as userName, u.avatar as userAvatar FROM replies r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.status = 'REMOVED' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM replies WHERE status = 'REMOVED'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE 1=1
AND status = #{status}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM replies WHERE 1=1
AND status = #{status}
